items.condition: Wrong cucurbituril ring graph, wrong guest multiplicity/charge or stoichiometry, claiming monomer pair observables, mislabeling full host removal as pure electrostatics, or substituting source endpoint coordinates for independent evidence invalidates dependent claims.

Fabricated or absent artifacts, unrelated raw runs, unresolvable object/record/quantity links, mismatched hashes or failed computations presented as completed evidence. A declared bounded failure is reportable but is not a complete answer.

Copied author numbers or a legacy scalar without evidence supporting the current question; prose-only mechanisms; missing necessary evidence hidden behind an unresolved label. Do not fail a valid alternative route merely for omitting a reference operation.

A vertical excitation or host-associated geometry is not by itself an emission wavelength, yield or kinetic mechanism. Removing an entire host changes more than electrostatics, so such a comparison cannot isolate pure electrostatics without further justification. A monomer has no interguest separation or pair splitting.
